title: 달빛 다리
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished story-stage landscape illustration, without any title or lettering. Opaque wide 16:9 at the largest available landscape resolution, intended for downscaling to 640x360 and display at 360-480px width. Reference 1 is the game's painted pixel-art style anchor; reference 2 is its story painting style; reference 3 is this realm's palette, architecture and landmarks. All are reference inputs, not edit targets. Match the crisp visible painted pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, rich but controlled colour, layered fantasy depth; no photographic or smooth 3D rendering. Cohesive nine-picture set rules: wide level establishing view, one dominant landmark centred horizontally in the MIDDLE THIRD, skyline/horizon around 70-74% image height in the LOWER THIRD, key environmental light from UPPER LEFT, midtone readability with dark blue-violet shadows, moderate saturation and contrast comparable to the other realms. Simple large shapes readable in a thumbnail. The outermost 3% on every side must be low-detail calm scenery safe for an 8px frame overlap, but DO NOT draw a frame. Keep the entire landmark in view. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, statues, letters, text-like decoration, glyphs, runes, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, borders or frames. No text anywhere. Stage 3, take B. ALFHEIM: a LONG moonlit bridge joining exactly TWO luminous ROUND moon gates, one at each end, beneath a LARGE CRESCENT MOON. Take B: level three-quarter perspective across a deep cloud-filled chasm; the bridge runs from x35% y77% to x65% y67%, creating a long diagonal receding span. Near ring at x35% y60%, far ring at x65% y56%, both clearly full circles and visibly attached to the opposite bridge ends; no extra portals. The bridge is central, not a close-up, with lots of quiet indigo sky and a low far cloud horizon at y72%. Large crescent in upper left at x23% y22% supplies silver moonlight. Restrained lavender foliage and dark blue-purple ruins around a clean bridge silhouette; no text, ornaments resembling script, banners or figures.
